note: Ground-floor café of the B61 half-timbered repair café: duck-egg-blue plaster between dark oak posts and beams, black-and-white chequered tiles, light from the bay window. LANDMARK: the bicycle-wheel chandelier hanging from the centre beam. The open doorway on the left goes back into the workshop (pegboard visible through it), the way back; the wooden staircase on the right goes UP to the first floor. Adjectives have no gender (divider null). Zoom: the cushioned bay-window bench at the back (z1).
